what_it_shows: Dim, lived-in vintage bathroom seen from the doorway: aqua/teal wall tile, shower curtain over a tub on the left (~15% width), teal toilet and cultured-marble vanity on the right (~75-85%), window with sheer curtain at ~50%, yellow-stained bath rug; very dated and tired, no people/text; portrait, so the 9:16 center crop keeps everything.

Corner tile shower stall in a dated 1990s style: two-tone white/terracotta-orange tile with a decorative border band and diamond accent tiles, basic chrome hose shower, dark mosaic floor with some grime on grout and lower tile; shower centered ~50% width; portrait, clean-ish but obviously old.

Close-up of a worn chrome tub/shower mixer with a white handheld shower in its cradle, water spots and grime on cream tile and a rust stain at the wall mount; mixer body ~55-60% width. A product box with printed text sits in the top-right corner (~75-95% width) - the 9:16 center crop (30-70%) excludes it; do not crop further right than ~70%.

1990s-style corner garden/soaker tub set into a white tiled deck, sage-green walls with two framed seashell prints and a chrome towel bar, beige ceramic floor tile with dark grout; tub spans ~15-80% (center ~45%); portrait. Dated rather than dirty; jets are not visible, but it reads as the classic builder-grade corner jacuzzi/garden tub.

Top-down view into an old tub corner: dingy, scuffed white tub with drain and chain plug, dated chrome taps, cracked/stained dark-teal and blue tile surround with a recessed ledge, two natural sponges on the rim; looks worn and neglected; subject ~50% width (taps ~40-55%).
